# Toolbar icons

Additional SVG paths in internal/ui/components/icon/editor_icons.go are from
the installed lucide v1.8.0 package (dist/esm/icons), under ISC.
The matching notice is EDITOR-LICENSE and is included in frontend-LICENSES.txt.

The application keeps its original selected Lucide 0.576.0 icons; these added
toolbar paths are identified separately. No icon font, React or remote asset is used.
